channels.request: read-only private pipe; bounded JSON then EOF
channels.events: write-only private pipe; bounded JSON lines; no paths, user IDs or credentials
channels.cancel: read-only private pipe; byte or EOF cancels
channels.secret: read-only distinct private pipe; lease JSON then EOF
channels.secretResult: write-only distinct private pipe; refreshed lease JSON
channels.secretAck: read-only distinct private pipe; strict owner/generation/accepted boolean CAS acknowledgement then EOF

context.accountOwner: opaque 64 lowercase hex binding, not email/IP/token

nativeSessionAPIProposed: beginAuthorization(expectedOwner) -> isolated OAuth attempt; initial UI and callback qualification still required
explicitDisconnect(owner) -> own Keychain entry only; never Galaxy credentials

capabilities.refreshAuthPrivateFD: tested with injected fake HTTP only; requires explicit networkAllowed and native lease/store integration
capabilities.v1v2ManifestParsing: real pinned upstream objects tested for osx/windows
capabilities.v2MissingFileTransferLibrary: real fixture writes, hashes, retries and atomic no-overwrite publication; authenticated chunk fetcher injected

progress.download: unique compressed chunks accepted after content+compressed MD5 validation
progress.transportBytes: actual received bytes including failed attempts
progress.speedBytesPerSecond: actual transport bytes / measured monotonic interval
progress.prepare: actual physical bytes written; progress null if counters exceed planned writes
progress.verify: actual bytes read and hashed; per-file stable signatures and final revalidation
progress.globalProgress: null; never reused for another stage
progress.stageHistory: full in-memory snapshots of observed stable stages; failures/cancellation stop active stages

resumePolicy.ownedRoot: account/product/platform marker + inode/device + private permissions + flock + directory FDs + no-follow
resumePolicy.temporaryCleanup: finally, exact owned staging files only

unqualified: real GOG account authorization and token refresh
production authenticated manifest/CDN binding and download routing
native executable/prerequisites and actual game launch
distribution: source-only preparation; no application inclusion or distributable helper package
